summary.text: Alan Baker is a Republican state representative from Alabama House District 66 who took office in 2006 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election. Baker is a former teacher and coach at T.R. Miller High School and has directed a mortgage and refinance business.

paragraphs.text: His professional experience includes working as director of a mortgage and refinance business and as a teacher and coach at T.R. Miller High School.

He has served on the boards of the American Red Cross of Escambia County, the Brewton Area Young Men's Christian Association, the Children's Advocacy Center and Habitat for Humanity, and he has been a member of the Brewton Kiwanis Club, the Escambia County Retired Educators Association and the First Baptist Church of Brewton.
Baker assumed office in the Alabama House in 2006.

In the 2025-2026 session Baker chaired the House Local Legislation Committee, was vice chair of the House Education Policy Committee, and also served on the Baldwin County Legislation Committee and the Ways and Means Education Committee.
